remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam at Amer. Place, March 1946" [note of backing inscriptions 1, 3 but without *]. Backing inscription dates 1920? Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1920. Abiquiú Notebooks dates c. 1920. Stretcher inscription 2 dates 1921 and indicates no 39 in 1923 New York (Anderson exhibition. Stretcher inscription 1 may indicate preparatory work. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix, figure 15. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription 2, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: 3 Zinnias

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: This small painting is comprised of three zinnias in front of a gray-blue background.  The zinnia on the left is a soft pink color, and it has a yellow center.  The middle flower is white and also has a yellow center.  The zinnia on the right is a darker pink around its edges with lighter pink highlights.  Its center is not visible.
title: 3 Zinnias
